docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $6,000.00 FILED BY WILLIAMS, WENDELL AS TO DEFENDANT PALILEO, PHIL ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-05-2012 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
APPLICATION PENDING FOR WAIVER OF COURT FEES AND COSTS PURSUANT TO G.C. 68633, CRC 3.51, 8.26, AND 8.818 (CONFIDENTIAL) FILED BY PLAINTIFF WILLIAMS, WENDELL
ORDER GRANTING WAIVER OF COURT FEES AND COSTS PURSUANT TO G.C. 68634 (E), CRC 3.52 AS TO PLAINTIFF WILLIAMS, WENDELL

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-05-2012 - CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF PLAINTIFF TO NOV-30-2012 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. "PLAINTIFF INDICATES THAT SHE WANTS TO ADD AN ADDITIONAL DEFENDANT (HER LANDLORD) AND ADD ADDITIONAL CAUSES OF ACTION AGAINST THE DEFENDANT, PALILEO (PROPERTY MANAGER)", JUDGE MITCHELL. PLAINTIFF MUST RE-SERVE BOTH DEFENDANTS. APPEARANCES BY BOTH PARTIES. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE IN OPEN COURT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (506)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. NO PROOF OF SERVICES. NO APPEARANCES BY BOTH PARTIES. PLAINTIFFS EXHIBITS NOT RETAINED. DEFENDANTS EXHIBITS NOT RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: BETSY JOHNSEN. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (506).
